name: I WANNA [_____] A CORPORATE ARCHDEMONESS
source:
CORPORATE ARCHDEMONESS ELISE HOLBROOK IS ON THE VERGE OF GETTING PARDONED IN AN ACT OF IMMENSE DEPRAVITY,  A RITE TO STAVE OFF THE BOREDOM OF AN UNENSOULED OLIGOGARCHY

SHE WILL SPEND THE REST OF HER LIFE REVILED, DRINKING HERSELF TO SLEEP IN THE MANSE OF THE MAN WHO CALLS HER MISTRESS. HER CURSED EXISTENCE IS A LIFE IN SOCIAL UNDEATH.

That is, unless one dead-end phlebotomist and duplicitous hung otaku girlfailure with a crush and vision for her can teach her how suited she is for a life in service to the lowest dregs of society, and the fact that former billionaire girls make wonderful BAD END heroines.

[From [url=https://dianerds.itch.io/corporate-archdemoness]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
企业大恶魔埃莉斯·霍尔布鲁克的行为极其堕落，即将获得赦免，这是一种为无情的寡头政治打发无聊的仪式

她将在被辱骂中度过余生，喝醉睡在那个自称情妇的男人的豪宅里。她被诅咒的存在是一种社会不死的生活。

也就是说，除非一个死胡同的抽血者和两面派的宅男女孩对她的迷恋和愿景失败了，才能教会她如何适合为社会最底层的渣滓服务的生活，以及前亿万富翁女孩成为出色的BAD END女主角的事实。
